import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforwardTransfer
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFunctorDef

/-!
# Coherence of quasi-coherent submodules

On a locally noetherian scheme, a quasi-coherent submodule of a finitely
presented module is finitely presented. This supplies the coherence of the
universal divisor candidate ideal before relative flattening in the
Grassmannian construction of Kleiman's divisor scheme.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

/-- A quasi-coherent submodule of a coherent module on a locally noetherian
scheme is coherent. On each affine open its sections embed in a finite module
over a noetherian ring, and hence are finite. -/
theorem isFinitePresentation_of_mono
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {M N : X.Modules} [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsFinitePresentation]
    (i : M ⟶ N) [Mono i] : M.IsFinitePresentation := by
  apply isFinitePresentation_of_finite_sections M
  intro U hU
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U, hU⟩
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(X, U) Γ(N, U) :=
    module_finite_sections_of_isFinitePresentation N ⟨U, hU⟩
  let f : Γ(M, U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(N, U) :=
    { (i.app U).hom with map_smul' := Hom.app_smul i }
  exact Module.Finite.of_injective f
    (PresheafOfModules.injective_of_mono
      ((toPresheafOfModules X).map i) (op U))

/-- A quasi-coherent quotient of a coherent module on a locally noetherian
scheme is coherent. Quasi-coherence of the kernel gives exactness on affine
sections. -/
theorem isFinitePresentation_of_epi
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {M N : X.Modules} [M.IsFinitePresentation] [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (q : M ⟶ N) [Epi q] [(kernel q).IsQuasicoherent] :
    N.IsFinitePresentation := by
  apply isFinitePresentation_of_finite_sections N
  intro U hU
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) :=
    module_finite_sections_of_isFinitePresentation M ⟨U, hU⟩
  let f : Γ(M, U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(N, U) :=
    { (q.app U).hom with map_smul' := Hom.app_smul q }
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective f (section_surjective_of_epi_qcoh q hU)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
